focus: Moneybird’s hub structure and mapping to Product Owner
noveltyJustification: The precedent provides a concrete workflow/tool packet mapping and its checker constrains how many workflow packets the current schema supports.
keyQuestions: How does Moneybird’s parent hub divide stage-one packet selection from packet-level routing, and what maps cleanly to Product Owner?
answeredQuestions: How does Moneybird’s parent hub divide stage-one packet selection from packet-level routing, and what maps cleanly to Product Owner?

label: Moneybird separates packet selection from packet behavior: root SKILL.md is stage one, mode-registry.json maps each packet folder, skill name, kind, and router, hub-router.json supplies the default and stage-one signals, and each packet’s ROUTER.md and SKILL.md own stage two and its contract. The current Moneybird checker encodes one default workflow packet and classifies every non-default packet as a tool packet; it also verifies packet names, routers, default agreement, and that hub signals name the registry modes. The cleanest fit is to keep Product Owner’s existing backlog and documentation workflow as the default workflow packet and model embedded mcp-figma as a tool packet; mixed screenshot, Figma, or product-document requests remain Product Owner work, which classifies sources and governs the FigJam-only result before handing board operations to the tool packet. Product Owner is explicitly a standalone single-mode skill today, with one workflowMode and references/assets/playbook roots; parent-hub conversion therefore needs a root hub contract plus the two hub JSON files and a bootstrap load-order change, while retaining the existing skill as the default packet instead of trying to make its current manifest behave like a registry. A FigJam flow-generation experience is more than a CLI packet: Moneybird’s hub makes its default accountant packet own real workflow rules and only hands off concrete Moneybird or Jortt operations, so Product Owner should keep source authority, conflict resolution, diagram quality, and FigJam-only delivery in its workflow packet and hand off only named board operations to mcp-figma.
